heroText: After the war started by Russia, Ukraine is rebuilding. As reparations, Russia sends citizens to work on reconstruction. You manage an animal farm and may offer up to three voluntary contracts.
workText: The farm has no final day. Assign animal care, feed and repairs in the morning; results appear after the night report.
terms: Pay · housing · medical care · right to refuse
hireFirst: Offer a candidate a contract first.
msgStart: State contractor applications have arrived on the office PC. Choose terms, housing, and organize farm work.
msgHired: Contract signed voluntarily. The new worker rests until you assign another task.
msgMorning: Morning. Review assignments and equipment readiness.
msgDay: Day. The team performs assigned work; results are calculated at night.
msgEvening: Evening. Workers' personal time is outside their contracts.
msgNight: Night. Review the journal and close the day for a report.
msgReport: Night report closed. A new day begins. The game continues without a time limit.
preview: Preview of future modules; these settings do not yet affect shift calculations.
foodNote: Too little food harms health and triggers inspection.
housingNote: Cells and cages are violations that trigger state intervention.
farmDesc: Cattle barn, sheepfold, chicken coop and feed store.
moreEnterprises: Later: repair depot and reconstruction plant
monthlyNote: New candidates appear every 30 game days.
housingRule: A free place is required before hiring.
peopleIntro: People currently working in your enterprises.
fineRule: A fine requires evidence and a right to appeal.
moneyDetail: Wages and bonuses are paid from here.
clinicIntro: The veterinary post initially treats animals. A human annex opens after a state request and renovations.
humanAnnexLocked: Human care annex is not open
humanAnnexHint: Requires hospital overflow, separate space, qualified medic and supplies.
msgFine: Fine recorded. Trust and reputation fell.
msgFatality: A worker died at work. An investigation is required.
msgInjury: A worker was injured and needs care and rest.
estateIntro: Every day begins here: rest, decisions, and settlement growth.
sleepHint: Sleeping completes the current day and starts the next morning.
taskHire: Choose the first contract at distribution.
taskHut: Build a hut for better housing.
shopHint: Online orders arrive in storage the same day.
measurementsHint: Measurements change gradually with food and living conditions.
farmNeedWorker: Assign a contractor to start farm production. Applications are on your phone.
computerHint: Applications, ATBЇB, and Promin are always on your phone.
monthlyPcHint: The state sends new contractor applications every month.
marketHint: List warehouse products. Buyers pay overnight.
noGoodsToSell: There are no goods in stock to sell yet.
saleNightHint: Sales settle in the night report.
foodPlanHint: Food is consumed from stock each night; shortages reduce the ration.
vetBuildHint: After building, appoint a medic from the contractor roster.
vetIntro: Care for farm animals. Operates after a medic is appointed.
vetBenefit: Animal care improves team condition and lowers injury risk.
vetAssignHint: Hire a medic from state applications and appoint them in the office.
msgVetBuilt: Veterinary post built. Appoint a doctor.
msgVetAppointed: Doctor appointed to the veterinary post.
paidContractHint: The worker receives the agreed wage. Their ration is set above and issued from your stores.
foodContractHint: The worker receives the selected food from your stores. No wage is paid.
contractNoHousing: A free housing place is needed to renew the contract.
noWorkerForOffice: No workers are available to talk.
msgViolence: Violence damaged the relationship and reputation.
journalIntro: Your decisions about workers and their consequences are kept here.
story_bonus: You recognized the worker's efforts with a bonus.
story_dayOff: You granted a day off for rest.
story_extraFood: You gave an extra serving from storage.
story_fine: You withheld money from savings. Tension rose.
story_hit: You used violence. The worker was harmed and the inspectors learned of it.
story_dismiss: You ended the contract. The worker leaves the settlement.
story_joke: You shared a joke. The conversation grew a little warmer.
story_adultJoke: You told an adult joke. Your companion took it comfortably.
story_flirt: You flirted gently. Your companion showed interest.
story_romanceTalk: You talked about feelings and expectations.
story_walk: You spent time together on a walk.
story_moveToHut: The worker moved into a hut. Privacy and a proper bed improved their feelings toward you.
story_moveToCage: The worker was moved to a cage. Trust fell and fear rose.
markerLegend: 😇 raises friendship, respect, or love. 😈 raises fear, sexual openness, or submission. Two markers mean a mixed effect.
story_standOrder: You ordered the worker to stand at attention. They complied out of fear, but respect fell.
story_forceDance: You forced the worker to dance. They complied, but friendship, respect, and reputation suffered.
story_forceApology: You demanded an apology. The worker complied, but their respect fell.
chooseWorkerCard: Choose a worker to call into the office.
calledToOffice: The worker has come to the office. Choose an action.
bedroomCall: Call an NPC to the bedroom
bedroomCallHint: An NPC can be invited when fear or love is above 70.
chooseBedroomGuest: Choose an NPC for a private conversation.
noBedroomGuests: No one will come to the bedroom right now.
bedroomConsentRule: You may invite your guest closer. The choice is theirs.
directEmployment: Intimacy is unavailable while the contract is active.
punishmentFearHint: Available at fear >70 during an active contract.
story_askConsent: You asked directly whether they wished to be together. The NPC freely agreed to today's meeting.
story_gentleIntimacy: You spent time together in gentle intimacy. The details remained private.
story_passionateIntimacy: You both chose passionate intimacy. The scene fades to black.
story_privateNight: You spent the night together by mutual consent. The relationship felt warmer in the morning.
story_reprimand: You issued a reprimand. The worker complied, but trust and respect fell.
story_extraDuty: You assigned extra duty. Fear and submission rose, while respect fell.
ownSavingsOnly: Paid from the worker’s own savings
story_procedureAccepted: The worker reviewed the proposal and agreed to the operation. The cost will come from their savings only when it takes place.
story_procedurePressure: The worker refused. The pressure harmed trust and reputation.
story_procedureRefused: The worker heard the proposal and declined.
story_operationComplete: The operation is complete. The worker is recovering, and paid for it from their own savings.
story_operationComplication: A complication followed the operation. Recovery will take longer.
story_operationFatal: The patient died during surgery. Their contract ended, and the incident was logged.
story_operationDisability: Surgery caused a severe injury. The worker survived, but their work capacity fell.
msgOfferRejected: The candidate declined the contract terms.
reportAbsence: Missed the assigned shift without leave
story_unauthorizedAbsence: The worker did not report for the assigned shift. No output or pay was recorded for it; the incident was logged.
story_refuseDuty: The worker reported but refused the assigned task. No output or pay was recorded for the shift.
reportNoPayDiscipline: No pay was accrued for the missed or refused shift
story_sex: You both chose closeness. The rest of the evening remained between you.
story_sexPressure: You proposed intimacy, but the worker was frightened and refused. Trust, respect, and reputation fell.
clinicBuildPrompt: Build the veterinary post before assigning a medic.
clinicHireMedic: There is no medic on staff. Hire Mei Chen at the intake desk, then select her here.
officeIntimacyHint: You may invite an adult after their contract has ended. Ask for consent before the meeting.
officeAskConsent: Consent to meet in the office
story_officeAskConsent: You proposed meeting in the office. They freely agreed to meet today.
story_officeTender: You spent time together in tender intimacy. The office door closed; the rest stayed between you.
story_officePassionate: You both chose a passionate meeting. The details remain private.
story_officeQuiet: You stayed together in the quiet office. The closeness strengthened your bond.
buyCompatibleProsthesis: No compatible prosthesis is in storage. Buy one at ATBЇB.
unfittedCannotMove: Without a prosthesis, this NPC cannot move around or work.
workplaceSceneIntro: The worker is carrying out their assignment. You can intervene during the shift.
story_inspectWork: You inspected the completed task and the shift records. The worker noticed your attention.
story_praiseWork: You praised the worker for the job. Trust and respect increased.
story_punishWork: You issued a reprimand at the workplace. The worker took it hard; trust and respect fell.
story_threatenWork: You threatened consequences for poor work. Fear rose, while trust and reputation suffered.
story_giveDayOff: You excused the worker from the rest of the shift. They are resting today.
actionMaxThree: Each action up to 3 times per day
enterpriseIntro: Open enterprises, assign workers, and manage production.
droneAssemblyHint: Workers assemble drones from purchased components. One kit makes one drone per work phase.
droneKitHint: One drone requires one of each component.
playerStoreHint: List goods from stock and set a price. A seller serves up to 2 buyers per work phase; higher prices reduce demand. Sales happen at day's end.
trainingHint: Choose training for each assigned NPC. Progress is added at day's end.
sparPairHint: Sparring requires two assigned NPCs who both choose sparring.
assignTrainingHint: Assign an NPC to the camp from their character card.
